## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Tang Vinaya manual by **Dàoxuān** 道宣 ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3), 596–667) on the canonical disposition of property left behind by a deceased monk (*wángsēng yīzī* 亡僧衣資). The technical distinction *qīngzhòng* 輕重 ("light and heavy") refers to the standard Vinaya division of monastic property into light (*qīngwù* — personal vestment, alms-bowl, books, etc., redistributed to the resident saṃgha) and heavy (*zhòngwù* — buildings, fields, durable property, retained by the monastery).

**Abstract**

The *Liàngchù qīngzhòng yí* is the principal Tang Vinaya manual on the canonical handling of a deceased monk's estate — a recurrent practical problem in monastic life that the various *vinaya* recensions handled inconsistently. Dàoxuān synthesises the principal positions of the *Sìfēnlǜ* 四分律, the *Sēngqí lǜ* 僧祇律, the *Wǔfēnlǜ* 五分律, and the *Shísònglǜ* 十誦律 into a single operational manual for the Tang monastic establishment. The work belongs to Dàoxuān's broader programme of institutional-ritual manuals ([KR6k0178](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0178) *Jiètán tújīng*, [KR6k0180](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0180) *Zhāngfú yí*, [KR6k0182](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0182) *Guījìng yí*, [KR6k0183](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0183) *Xínghù lǜyí*) that defined Tang monastic practice. Composition belongs to Dàoxuān's mature *Zhōngnán* period.
